action: Companies serving EU customers: list all GDPR rights in the privacy statement, offer an easy way to exercise them, and publish privacy pages in the languages of the countries served.
date_note: Security.nl published the report on 20 November 2026; it gives no date for the AP decision, which was not read.
exec: Regulators fine firms for incomplete privacy information and hard-to-use rights channels, not only for breaches.
plain: The Dutch privacy regulator fined the company On That Ass 90,000 euros for failing to tell customers about their privacy rights and making them hard to use.
summary: According to Security.nl, the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) fined On That Ass 90,000 euros for violating the GDPR. Three fines totalling 95,000 euros were reduced by 5% after the company's objection because of exceeding a reasonable time limit. The AP found the privacy statement omitted some rights, rights could be used only by post, and privacy pages were not in all relevant languages.
title: Dutch DPA fines On That Ass 90,000 euros over GDPR transparency failures

validation.note: Single publisher (Security.nl) read; the AP decision page returned 403 to automated readers and was not read.
